name: GFB Scottish Pub
description: GFB Scottish pub offers a lively karaoke experience with a welcoming atmosphere. Known for its great live music, karaoke nights, and friendly staff, it provides a fun environment for all ages. The venue features a good sound system, a decent song selection, and a variety of entertainment options including darts, pool, and table games. Open year-round, it's a popular spot for locals and visitors seeking good drinks, food, and memorable karaoke nights.
